summary: Controlled choice among poll options, without submission or results.
whenToUse: Collecting a single selection to pass to the consumer.
whenNotToUse: To vote on content use PostList and VoteButton; submission and results stay external.

keyboard.action: Navigates and selects an option via RadioGroup.

accessibility: Uses the design system’s accessible RadioGroup and a visible label.
customization: RadioGroup manages states; the layout uses --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: This component does not submit votes, calculate results or pick a winner.
limits: The consumer handles submission and counts.
